header.userPrompt:
Print the run's open review findings to the run output at the end of a code flow, whether or not a PR is opened, and make the using-orca skill show them to the user.

Context: today the open findings (OpenFindings returned by the review loops) reach only the PR body, via bodyWithOpenFindings (flow/src/main/scala/orca/pr/bodyWithOpenFindings.scala). The run log has no combined list. When no PR is opened (repo not on GitHub, push refused, gh pr create failed; see openPrIfGitHub.scala `skipped`/`attempt`), the findings are not visible anywhere.

Changes:
1. In orca.pr, openPrIfGitHub and openPrFromBranch emit the open findings to the run output (an OrcaEvent, e.g. Step, or whatever event fits best for a multi-line block) in every case: PR opened, PR skipped, push/create refused, and on a resumed run. Emit nothing when there are no open findings. Reuse the same heading ("Open review findings") and bullet formatting as the PR body section: extract the shared rendering out of bodyWithOpenFindings so both use one implementation, and the PR body output stays byte-identical to today.
2. Update skills/using-orca/SKILL.md "After it runs": when the run finishes, show the user the "Open review findings" block from the log verbatim, or say the review left nothing open when the block is absent. Keep it short.
3. Update README/docs if they describe where open findings are reported.
4. Tests: cover that the findings are emitted when a PR is opened and when it is skipped, and nothing is emitted when there are none. Follow the existing test style for orca.pr.

Follow AGENTS.md conventions; load the direct-style-scala skill before writing Scala.

resultJson.title: Show open review findings in run output
resultJson.body:
**Summary**

Previously, open review findings reached only the PR body (when a PR opened successfully). Runs that had no PR — due to not being on GitHub, a failed push, or a failed PR creation — showed no findings anywhere. The run output now prints the same "Open review findings" section in all cases: PR opened, PR skipped, or operations refused.

**Changes**

Extracted the "Open review findings" section rendering into a shared `openFindingsSection` function. Created `reportingOpenFindings` to wrap a step, emit findings to the run output on exit (including when the step throws), and print nothing when nothing is open. Applied this wrapper to `openPrFromBranch` and `openPrIfGitHub` so findings print whether the PR succeeds or fails. Tests cover both cases. Updated README, AGENTS.md, and the using-orca skill to document that findings appear in run output.
